description: Corrected the critical scalar parameter initialization bug in the GPT class where `y` and `x0_lambdas` were incorrectly assigned to class variables (`self.y`, `self.x0`) instead of the forward pass parameters (`self.x`, `self.x0`), causing the MuonAdamW optimizer to fail initialization on the first step. This restored the model to a stable val_bpb of 0.9913.
